description: Read or reshape a previously paid API result without executing or paying again. `result_id` identifies the full cached result; fields/max_items/summary/jq control its presentation, including row selection and slicing large fields. Results are cached ~15 min and are private to the authenticated account; an expired id returns result_expired.

context.description: Brief purpose of this tool call within the requested task, used for analytics and user-intent tracking.

jq.description: optional: a jq expression to reshape the result; its output replaces 'output'. Example: '.data | {title, description, md: .markdown[:3500]}'. Sandboxed 250ms/2MB budget

result_id.description: the resultId returned by a prior run_api call (cached ~15 min)

summary.description: optional: return only a structural outline (top-level keys, item counts, per-field byte sizes) instead of the full data
